# Introduction
AuthMeTitles is a plugin that allows you to send Sounds and display Titles (Static or Animated), ActionBars and BossBars during the login and registration.

# Features
- 1.8 - Newer Versions Support.
- Fully Customizable.
- HEX Color Codes Support.
- PlaceholderAPI Support (use placeholders in Titles, ActionBars and BossBars).
- Sends Sounds during the login and registration.
- Displays Titles (Static or Animated), ActionBars and BossBars during the login and registration.
- Automatic Configuration File Updater.

# Requirements
1. Spigot
2. AuthMeReloaded
3. PlaceholderAPI (Optional)

# How To Install
1. Download AuthMeTitles.jar from this page.
2. Download AuthMeReloaded.
3. Download PlaceholderAPI (Optional).
4. Put AuthMeTitles, AuthMeReloaded and PlaceholderAPI inside your plugins folder.
5. Start your server.

# Commands

```
/authmetitles help - Sends a message with all commands and permissions.
/authmetitles reload | rl - Reloads the configuration file.
```

# Permissions

```
authmetitles.* - Allows to execute all commands.
authmetitles.help - Allows to see all commands and permissions.
authmetitles.reload - Allows to reload the configuration file.
```
